title: Lens word explanation response
description: The object the model is asked to return inside choices[0].message.content. Validation reads this file for the required field list, so the code and API.md cannot drift apart.

results.description: One entry per requested word, echoed in any order.

word.description: The input word, spelled exactly as requested.

etymology.description: One short sentence on where the word came from, in the explanation language. Optional: it is asked for only when the etymology setting is on, and a word whose origin is unknown has none.

senses.description: Distinct senses in descending frequency order; Lens retains at most three.
